findings.summary: The migrate-failure case no longer increments `failed`, so the final summary and exit code silently understate/ignore real mirror failures.
findings.mechanism: Old code had `failed=$((failed + 1))` in the `*)` branch alongside the error echo; the rewritten `*)` branch only echoes the error and drops the counter increment. `failed` stays 0 even when migrate calls fail, so `[[ "$failed" -eq 0 ]] || exit 1` at the end never fires and the printed `failed=0` summary is wrong — a nightly cron failure goes unnoticed.
